newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - RTF H1 PROFIT 1.8 MLN LATS.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - RTF H1 PROFIT 1.8 MLN LATS.

text.p: Riga Transport Fleet made a first half profit of 1.802 million lats on net turnover of 3.96 million lats, the bourse said on Friday.
The company's gross profit was 658,376 lats and it had income from stakes in daughter companies of 1.20 million lats.
Its administrative costs were 220,626 lats and it had no sales expenses.
The profit before tax and extraordinary items was 1.85 million lats. Its extraordinary income was 372,647 lats and its extraordinary expenses were 227,939 lats.
The company paid taxes of 195,598 lats.
The company's assets amounted to 22.8 million lats and it had long-term debts of 279,154 lats. Its short-term debt was 2.45 million lats.
